title: LoginIp - Data API
description: Represents a validated IP address. This object is available in version 28.0 and later.

ChallengeMethod.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
ChallengeMethod.description: The challenge method used to confirm the user’s identity. Possible values include the following. Email SMS TOTP_CHOICE: The user chooses multi-factor authentication. TOTP_ONLY: The user is required to use multi-factor authentication.

ChallengeSentDate.description: The date and time that the user was authenticated.

IsAuthenticated.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort
IsAuthenticated.description: If true, the user has already been authenticated.

SourceIp.description: The IP address the user logged in from.

UsersId.description: The ID of the user associated with this item. This is a relationship field.

usage: At every login, the IP address of the login request is checked against the validated IP addresses using LoginIp. A match means the login IP address is a known IP address. If there’s no match, the address is unknown, and the user is asked to confirm their identity.
wsdl_segment:
```xml
<simpleType name="ID">
  <restriction base="xsd:string">
    <length value="18"/>
    <pattern value="[a-zA-Z0-9]{18}"/>
  </restriction>
</simpleType>
<complexType name="LoginIp">
  <complexContent>
    <extension base="ens:sObject">
      <sequence>
        <element name="ChallengeMethod" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="ChallengeSentDate" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime"/>
        <element name="CreatedDate" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime"/>
        <element name="IsAuthenticated" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:boolean"/>
        <element name="SourceIp" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="Users" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="ens:User"/>
        <element name="UsersId" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
      </sequence>
    </extension>
  </complexContent>
</complexType>
```
